arjuna.title: Arjuna - World History Encyclopedia
arjuna.summary: Arjuna is one of the five Pandava brothers and a master archer in the Mahabharata. Before the Kurukshetra battle, he asks his charioteer Krishna to stop between the armies. Seeing relatives, friends, and his teacher Drona on the opposing side, he loses heart and refuses to fight. This crisis becomes the setting of the Bhagavad Gita, where Krishna responds as teacher and guide by explaining duty and right action.

asa.title: BABYMONSTER Makes a Grand Comeback with Their Debut Full Album
asa.summary: YG Entertainment identifies ASA as a member of BABYMONSTER. Its description of the group's first full album singles out Woke Up In Tokyo (RUKA & ASA) as a track that showcases the hip-hop style of the group's two Japanese members, giving Asa a specific musical role beyond basic membership.

andrew-musk.title: Elon Musk hires two of his cousins for Twitter
andrew-musk.summary: Andrew Musk is Elon Musk's cousin. Reporting on Twitter's reorganization identifies Andrew with software-engineering work at Twitter and notes that he had previously worked at Neuralink. This source is used only to establish the correct Andrew Musk and his technical role; the service's faction context supplies the narrower episode context.

bae.title: NMIXX Official Profile - BAE
bae.summary: JYP Entertainment's official NMIXX profile lists BAE, Korean name 배이, as a member of NMIXX and gives her birth date as 2004-12-28. This source fixes the identity to the singer Bae of NMIXX, not another person or place named Bae.

d.o..title: EXO's D.O. profile after joining Company Soosoo
d.o..summary: The profile identifies D.O. as an EXO member who works both as a singer and as an actor, and notes that he continued EXO activities after joining Company Soosoo for his individual work. This source fixes the identity to Do Kyung-soo of EXO.

james-hetfield.title: Metallica's momentous One record
james-hetfield.summary: James Hetfield co-wrote Metallica's song One. The song drew on Dalton Trumbo's anti-war novel Johnny Got His Gun and follows a severely wounded soldier trapped inside his body. Its video combined performance footage with scenes and dialogue from the film adaptation, became Metallica's first music video, broadened the band's audience through MTV, and the song won Metallica's first Grammy.

james-musk.title: Elon Musk hires two of his cousins for Twitter
james-musk.summary: James Musk is Elon Musk's cousin. Reporting on Twitter's reorganization describes James as a fixer-type figure brought into the company alongside Andrew Musk. This source is used to establish the correct James Musk and his role around the reorganization; the service's faction context supplies the narrower episode context.

jang-wonyoung.title: 아이즈원 장원영, 스타쉽 새 걸그룹 합류
jang-wonyoung.summary: 한국일보는 장원영이 프로젝트 그룹 아이즈원 활동을 마친 뒤 스타쉽엔터테인먼트의 새 걸그룹 아이브에 합류했다고 보도했다. 이 이력은 현재 아이브 멤버라는 기본 안내와 별개로, 한시적 프로젝트 그룹에서 활동한 가수가 새 고정 그룹으로 다시 데뷔한 경력의 전환을 설명할 수 있게 한다.

jay.title: BELIFT LAB ENHYPEN Official Profile - JAY
jay.summary: JAY, born 2002-04-20, is a member of ENHYPEN. The group was assembled from the final contestants of the audition program I-LAND and debuted on 2020-11-30. BELIFT LAB describes the group's name as different people connecting to discover one another and grow together.

jeongyeon.title: TWICE Discography - Formula of Love: O+T=<3
jeongyeon.summary: JYP Entertainment's official TWICE discography identifies 1, 3, 2, performed by JEONGYEON, MINA, and TZUYU, as one of the first unit songs released by TWICE. This gives Jeongyeon a concrete musical episode separate from the basic fact that she is a TWICE member: within a nine-member group, she also participated in the group's first three-member unit-song format.

dmitry-khoroshev.title: U.S. Charges Russian National with Developing and Operating LockBit Ransomware
dmitry-khoroshev.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice identifies Dmitry Yuryevich Khoroshev as LockBitSupp and alleges that he developed and administered LockBit. The release says the group attacked more than 2,500 victims in at least 120 countries and extracted at least $500 million in ransom payments; U.S. authorities offered up to $10 million for information leading to his arrest or conviction.

king-faisal.title: Faisal Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud - Saudipedia
king-faisal.summary: Saudipedia identifies Faisal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, born in 1906 and died in 1975, as the third king of Saudi Arabia. He served as king from 1964 until his assassination in 1975 and had already held leading government and foreign-policy roles before taking the throne.

jumong.title: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Literature - Jumong Myth
jumong.summary: The National Folk Museum of Korea's encyclopedia describes the Jumong narrative recorded in the Samguk sagi and Samguk yusa. Jumong leaves Buyeo, reaches Jolbon, and founds Goguryeo as King Dongmyeong; the founding story presents him as an extraordinary archer and a heaven-descended ruler.

marquis-wen-of-wei.title: The Prince: The State of Wei, 446-396 BCE
marquis-wen-of-wei.summary: Oxford Academic identifies Wei Si as the ruler later known as Marquis Wen of Wei. It describes his cultivation of capable officials regardless of birth, Li Kui's legal and administrative reforms, the strengthening and expansion of Wei, and Wei Si's successful effort to receive the rank of marquis from the Zhou king.

noah-urban.title: Palm Coast Hacker Sentenced To 10 Years In Prison
noah-urban.summary: The U.S. Attorney's Office identifies Noah Michael Urban as King Bob and says he received a ten-year federal prison sentence after pleading guilty to wire-fraud conspiracy, wire fraud, and aggravated identity theft. The case describes targeted SIM-swap attacks used to take personal information and steal cryptocurrency from at least 59 victims. This release does not attribute the MGM or Caesars attacks to Urban personally, so those claims must not be added to his reading from the internal context alone.

sheikh-zaki-yamani.title: Sheikh Ahmed Zaki Yamani: an OPEC and oil industry pioneer
sheikh-zaki-yamani.summary: OPEC's obituary identifies Ahmed Zaki Yamani as Saudi Arabia's minister of petroleum and mineral resources from 1962 to 1986. It describes his nearly quarter-century ministerial tenure and his central role in OPEC and the global oil industry.

suseribime.title: Encyclopedia of Shinto - Suseribime
suseribime.summary: Kokugakuin University's Encyclopedia of Shinto identifies Suseribime in the Kojiki as Susanoo's daughter and Onamuchi's principal wife. It recounts how she helped Onamuchi survive Susanoo's trials and escape the underworld, after which he took the name Okuninushi and ruled the land with her as his principal wife.

wonbin.title: Get a Guitar - performance history
wonbin.summary: RIIZE debuted with Get a Guitar. At the 2023 Melon Music Awards, the group performed the song with a live band, and Wonbin opened the stage with a guitar solo before the other members joined him. This gives Wonbin a concrete performance episode beyond the basic fact that he is a RIIZE member.

yuna.title: ITZY Discography - BORN TO BE
yuna.summary: JYP Entertainment's official ITZY discography lists Yet, but (유나) among the ten tracks on BORN TO BE. It is a member-specific solo track placed inside an ITZY album, giving Yuna an individual musical episode separate from her basic identity as an ITZY member.

yunho.title: ATEEZ members reflect on acting in Imitation
yunho.summary: Four ATEEZ members appeared in the KBS drama Imitation. Yunho played Yoo Jin, the center of the fictional idol group Sparkling, and discussed the role after the drama ended. This acting debut provides a concrete subject separate from his basic identity and performance role in ATEEZ.

yuta.title: YUTA's Road To Depth
yuta.summary: The Recording Academy describes Yuta's first solo album Depth as a deliberate clean slate after his work in NCT 127. Yuta centered the record on rock and alternative rock, using the solo release to present music distinct from his group work. This is a separate subject from his basic identity as a Japanese member of NCT 127.

winter.title: SM launches new female supergroup
winter.summary: KBS World reports that Winter of aespa was selected for GOT the beat, the first unit in SM Entertainment's Girls On Top project. The seven-member group joined artists from different generations and existing acts: BoA, Girls' Generation's Taeyeon and Hyoyeon, Red Velvet's Seulgi and Wendy, and aespa's Karina and Winter. This project-group participation is a separate subject from Winter's basic identity as an aespa member.
